verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI documents cron-based scheduling of agents that 'persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session,' explicitly for 'recurring automations like daily summaries and code reviews' (cline-docs-13, 23, 36), plus chat-triggered agents via Slack/Discord/Telegram/Linear and headless operation in CI/CD pipelines (cline-docs-17), combined with auto-approve/YOLO mode for unattended autonomous execution (cline-docs-21, 22). missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the scheduling feature actually working reliably in production, and more detail on trigger-based (non-cron) autonomous maintenance workflows
